bullets.text: Cellnex Delivers for VodafoneThree - **Cellnex** completes its first consolidated site for **VodafoneThree**, enhancing 4G and 5G coverage ahead of schedule.
Verizon's Major Layoffs - **Verizon** plans to cut 15,000 jobs as part of a restructuring strategy amid intense market competition.
Nokia Expands Data Center Portfolio - **Nokia** introduces new switches to enhance data throughput and support AI workloads in data centers.
Private 5G Meets Generative AI - The integration of **private 5G** and **generative AI** is transforming industrial connectivity and intelligence.
Connected Germany 2025 Conference - Key industry leaders will gather to address Germany's digital challenges and connectivity goals.
Vodacom Partners with Starlink - **Vodacom** collaborates with **Starlink** to enhance mobile backhaul services across rural Africa.
Amazon Leo Launches Satellite Service - **Amazon** rebrands its satellite initiative as **Amazon Leo**, aiming to compete with **SpaceX's** Starlink.
Deutsche Telekom's Strong Q3 - **Deutsche Telekom** reports record fiber gains and emphasizes AI as a core business pillar.
Safaricom Defends M-Pesa - **Safaricom** resists government pressure to spin off its successful mobile money platform, **M-Pesa**.
